tracks.name: Ronski Speed & Syntrobic feat. Renee Stahl — Pink Skye
tracks.file: Ronski Speed & Syntrobic feat. Renee Stahl-Pink Skye.mp3
tracks.notes: Inizio=0.476s, phase=1. Enter at bar 29 (fill at 32 = distraction anchor). 9A throughout intro.

transitions.notes: Deep Style bars 199-207 overlap with Foss bars 0-8 (pre-Inizio hum). Deep Style out by Foss RB bar 2 (engine bar ~8). Exp fade keeps both tracks fuller during overlap.
Mood transition. Foss full run to 165 — 20 bars quiet tail. LP 800 on Alone with exp ramp (power=3) — synth stays tamed early, opens up late. No sudden pop.
BPM jump 123->126. Alone rides 9B outro to silence, Am I Dreaming vocal resets.
Both 126 BPM. 7A->4B. Outgoing hold: kasa vocals at full volume, Otoño LP 500 ramp builds underneath. Slam cut at Otoño bar 15.75 (drums). Alt: 8.25 for longer transition feel.
4B->2A. 16-bar ramp (8 solo on Otoño, 8-bar crossfade). 3-band on LD: kill bass, tame mids, partial highs — ramp all to full. Exp fade power=6.

Percussive bridge. 2A->1A (perfect neighbor). Tempo ramp 128->129.2 over 17 bars. 3-band on LD outgoing: power=3 delayed rolloff — stays full through midpoint, then drops mids/highs fast to clear for Sleeping vocals.

1A->1A perfect harmonic match. 80-bar fader automation. PQM vocal callback at bar 38(247) is the distraction anchor — Quivver slides in during vocal, established by the time it ends. Mute Quivver during PQM quiet zone (30-38).

1A->1A but basslines clash despite rhythmic alignment. Quivver cue_out=237 (beat section end), BTB cue_in=17 (beat section start). 2-bar softener — NEEDS PRO FEEDBACK. Kicks align but melodic bass creates ghost beats in any longer overlap.
HARD transition (1A->9A, 4 Camelot steps). Distraction anchor: PS enters at bar 29, fill at 32 (perc drop 70%) masks key change. BTB exits at 241 (wind-down). HP 500 on BTB outgoing.
9A->8B, 6/7 shared notes. Comfortable overlap. Sin-curve gain hump +3.5dB at midpoint compensates equal_power volume dip — measured flat to -0.3dB.
